title: Battle of the Faubourg St Antoine
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of the Faubourg St Antoine", at revision 1377777409, opens: "The Battle of the Faubourg Saint Antoine occurred on 2 July 1652 during the Fronde rebellion in France. It is named after the Faubourg Saint-Antoine, a district near the Bastille in the east of Paris, where the battle took place." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890900, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1652 battle in France". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
